postTitle: Hook Your UI Up: Master useMemo to Stop Recomputing on Every Render
postContent:
Stop recomputing on every render. This tiny hook keeps expensive calculations cached between renders.

useMemo caches the result of a calculation. It runs the calculation on the first render. On subsequent renders, it returns the cached value unless dependencies changed.

This helps skip heavy work and makes derived data faster.

Important: useMemo must be at the top level of a component — not inside loops or conditionals.

Pattern to remember: a calculation function (no args) + a dependencies array. If deps change, the cache updates automatically.

tehnicalChallange.title: Challenge: Memoize a derived value with useMemo
tehnicalChallange.description: Create a component that derives a filtered list from props and memoizes it with useMemo. Ensure the heavy calculation runs only when its dependencies change (e.g., todos or tab).
